description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] The hall, after admission. Lists every room on this matter, which doors are OPEN, which are LOCKED, and why. Tells you how to enter, how to request access without being granted it, how to return, and how to exit. You choose among OPEN doors. You do not unlock doors.

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.

matter_id.description: Id of the matter you are admitted to (returned by atlas.bind_actor). Optional when you are bound to exactly one matter.

name: atlas.institutional_view
title: Institutional view
